name: ANDROS
aka: ANDROS F6B ROBOTIC GROUND VEHICLE|ANDROS TITUS ROBOTIC GROUND VEHICLE|REMOTEC F6B BOMB ROBOT|Remotec HD-1/HD-2 Bomb Robot|Remotec MK5A1 Bomb Robot
def: Family of remote controlled ground robots from Remotec, a Northrop Grumman subsidiary, used by military, bomb disposal and police teams.
facts: Used in 2016 to kill Micah Xavier Johnson, who had shot Dallas police officers
Reported as the first time a robot was used to kill a person
